title: Works ok
text: Works ok. The instant pot works good for cooking rice. It’s not very hard to clean but it’s not that non sticky. It’s pretty small but big enough for one or two people.

product_metadata.title: Instant Pot Zest Plus 20 Cup Cooked rice, 5Litre Rice Cooker,Steamer, Slow Cooker,13 One Touch Programs, No Pressure Cooking Functionality
features: Precision heat, non-pressure cooking, and one-touch simplicity make cooking your family’s favorite rice and grains super-fast and one-touch easy
9 Smart Programs for cooking white rice, brown rice, mixed grains, quinoa, barley, couscous, bulgur oatmeal and risotto, and plus 4 more for sauté, steam, slow cook and keep warm
More than a rice cooker: quickly steam veggies, fish and more with ease. Doubles as a family-size warmer for foods of all kinds
Automatically adjusts cooking time to the amount of ingredients you add. Built-in protection against overheating
Extra thick inner pot with non-stick ceramic coating for better, more even cooking. Lightweight and easy to store
Accessories included: dishwasher-safe steamer tray, rice measuring cup and rice spoon
120 Volt 60 Hertz power supply - Please check your voltage if not in North America
